question: Should `tool-progress` become the public generic plugin-SDK reply-payload contract for cross-plugin progress handling, or remain behind a narrower internal bundled-plugin seam?
rationale: Code inspection establishes that the implementation is coherent, but it cannot determine whether third-party plugins should permanently depend on this new metadata contract.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive constant and predicate as the canonical typed progress intent for plugins and channels.

options.title: Narrow it to bundled internals
options.body: Preserve the Slack behavior while exposing the progress marker only through an internal bundled-plugin facade.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive constant and predicate as the canonical typed progress intent for plugins and channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership spans both the Slack delivery path and the reply-payload SDK boundary involved in this decision.
